notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital 3.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Today's update introduces challenge balance adjustments, AI improvements, bug fixes, and a variety of quality-of-life upgrades. It also brings [i]Immortality[/i] to the Skirmish rotation, along with new rules and scoring mods that showcase mechanics from the expansion.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/ff23cd1022a4ba6801b09b6fe103a99b19341048.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][p][/p][h3]Ranked, Skirmish, and Challenge Updates[/h3][list][*][p]The current Ranked season now uses the Go to 11 Rules variant.[/p][/*][*][p]The next Skirmish reset will include Immortality and Base mods, starting a new rotation that follows this pattern:[/p][list][*][p]Immortality and Base mods[/p][/*][*][p]Ix + Base mods[/p][/*][*][p]Base mods[/p][/*][*][p]Immortality and Base mods, repeat[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Balance changes were made to the following Challenges: [/p][list][*][p]The Kwisatz Haderach Heroic[/p][/*][*][p]Snooping Normal and Heroic[/p][/*][*][p]Neutral Shipping Conglomerate Heroic[/p][/*][*][p]Introduction to Ix Heroic[/p][/*][*][p]Clandestine Meeting Normal and Heroic[/p][/*][*][p]Research Assignment Heroic[/p][/*][*][p]Bribery Heroic[/p][/*][*][p]Stillsuit Testing Heroic.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Tooltipping the Foldspace board space should now display the number of Foldspace cards in the Reserve[/p][/*][*][p]Deck icons for both local and enemy players are now the same shape.[/p][/*][*][p]Alliance token icons for both local and enemy players are now in the same order.[/p][/*][*][p]Conditional Agent icons on cards are now easier to read[/p][/*][*][p]The Harvest Specimen icon was updated to more clearly indicate that the troop(s) are returning to your supply.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hotkey "I" for expanding and collapsing the Imperium Row[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning for grafting Ghola to cards like Power Play which will not allow you to gain extra Influence.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new SFX for graft and specimen abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]In games with a modified endgame threshold, such as the Go to 11 variant, a visual indicator was added to the user’s VP icon indicating the new threshold.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Ranked, Skirmish and Challenges[/h3][list][*][p]Placeholder stars should no longer display under the Ranked badge when a player is Master rank.[/p][/*][*][p]The Rank Up prompt should no longer display text about earning stars when the player is Master rank"[/p][/*][*][p]If undo is used after gaining the first Alliance in the Deadly Alliance rules mod, Full-Scale Assault should now be acquirable when an Alliance is next gained.[/p][/*][*][p]The in-game tracker for the Technological Diversity Skirmish rules mod should now track points instead of the number of Tecs acquired.[/p][/*][*][p]The Skirmish gamepad Resume prompt close button should now be centered.[/p][/*][*][p]The animation for the Deadly Alliance Skirmish rules modifier should now indicate that you acquired a Full Scale Assault card.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Prepare for the Storm challenge, Fremen Bond abilities from drafted cards should now trigger for AI players correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Prepare for the Storm heroic challenge, AI players should no longer start with a Convincing Argument in their deck.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Prepare for the Storm challenge, Guild Ambassador should no longer be used in Pool 4 of the AI's draft instead of Guild Administrator.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Display Issues[/h3][list][*][p]The game mode description for House Hagal in the Create Game screen should now explain Expert Troop Deployment.[/p][/*][*][p]Selected factions in prompts should now appear brighter.[/p][/*][*][p]The Rise of Ix (ROI) image should now be centered properly in the Ranked screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Rhombur’s Buy Tech prompt should now have the correct thumbnail image.[/p][/*][*][p]The Trash prompt for Stitched Horror should now have the correct thumbnail image.[/p][/*][*][p]Water Peddler's cost icons should now be consistent with other cards and appear within the card’s border.[/p][/*][*][p]The Trash prompt for the Research track should now have the correct thumbnail.[/p][/*][*][p]The Research Track, Imperium Row window, Action Log, and Trash / Discard window should now each collapse when any of the others is expanded. [/p][/*][*][p]The opponent reveal animation should now include the total persuasion and strength generated from all sources.[/p][/*][*][p]After grafting a card to Chairdog during an Agent turn, if you reveal and then undo, the card should now retain its dimmed appearance in the play area.[/p][/*][*][p]Board spaces to which you can infiltrate an Agent should no longer appear darkened.[/p][/*][*][p]If Reverend Mother Mohiam is grafted to Ghola, animations showing the discarded cards should appear for both discard effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Undoing a Reveal turn while you have Minimic Film should no longer cause your Persuasion count to briefly increment.[/p][/*][*][p]When grafting Usurp to Reverend Mother Mohiam in the Imperium Row, the corresponding animation should now show opponents' discarded cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Observer mode should now display Epic and Go to 11 icons in the HUD.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay - Rules[/h3][list][*][p]If Ghola copies an Agent box that provides troops, the short or no troop warnings should now appear if appropriate.[/p][/*][*][p]Imperium Row should now reopen after using Research from Tleilaxu Master.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Acquire Foldspace" ability button should no longer appear when there are no more Foldspace cards available to acquire.[/p][/*][*][p]Slig Farmer should now grant the correct amount of Solari when grafted onto a card with conditional Agent icons which have been modified by Dispatch an Envoy.[/p][/*][*][p]Scientific Breakthrough’s research ability should now defer when it's used to send an Agent to a space which draws cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Using For Humanity's reveal ability and choosing a new Alliance leader due to a tie should no longer cause the Influence to be lost twice..[/p][/*][*][p]Discard abilities that draw cards should now have a "cannot undo" hover icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Playing Twisted Mentat while The Voice’s effect is active should no longer extend its effect another turn.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay - AI[/h3][list][*][p]AI players should now make better choices around grafting Ghola and Chairdog.[/p][/*][*][p]AI players should make better use of Long Reach’s conditional Agent icons ability.[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements to how AI players calculate reveal ability values.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay - Action Log[/h3][list][*][p]All research track abilities should now have Action Log entries.[/p][/*][*][p]The Influence gain from acquiring Memocorders should now appear in the Action Log.[/p][/*][*][p]If Kwisatz Haderach is used to send an Agent to Secrets and an Intrigue card is drawn, the Intrigue card should now appear in the Action Log.[/p][/*][*][p]Resource gain Action Logs from playing Breakthrough should now appear as a sub-entry beneath it.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Players should no longer be able to use hotkeys to open the Bene Tleilax board in non-Immortality games.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed various localization issues.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our goal is to deliver the play experience you deserve and expect. To that end, we review any and all reports you send us. We appreciate your feedback, and to continue to help us make [i]Dune Imperium: Digital[/i] the best it can be, be sure to reach out to us at [url="https://support@direwolfdigital.com"]support@direwolfdigital.com[/url] or via the [u][url="https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital"]Dire Wolf Discord[/url][/u] if you have anything to report![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing, and happy gaming! [/p]

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital 3.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, leaders of the Great Houses![/p][p][/p][p]Today’s patch contains continued fixes for stability, functionality, and quality of life following the release of the Immortality DLC. Some highlights include a bevy of visual fixes, corrected functionality for new cards, and a series of AI upgrades which should make it feel more intelligent when playing with Immortality.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/90885fb21abeaece00f5ae1f718b9beb20d6198e.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Client Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Blank Slate should now display its “If Grafted” icons when you play it before the card you Graft to it.[/p][/*][*][p]When using a gamepad to advance on the Research Track, the player pip should animate smoothly to the next space.[/p][/*][*][p]Agent icons on cards in hand should no longer flicker when undoing an action or ending your turn.[/p][/*][*][p]When tooltipping a card, agent icons should now animate in more smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]Long Reach's conditional agent icons should now display as enabled when you have a Bene Gesserit Graft card in hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Discarding should no longer be mandatory when triggering two snooper tokens in the same turn.[/p][/*][*][p]When previewing the Tech Tile tray during an opponent's turn, the displayed Techs will update if another player purchases from one of the Tech piles.[/p][/*][*][p]Dispatch an Envoy should now only cause faction icons it actually adds to glow, instead of making all faction icons on a card glow.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]The Overpowering Dread challenge special rule should no longer give players Immortality intrigue cards.[/p][/*][*][p]If you use Usurp’s graft ability to gain and deploy troops, and undo the deployment, you should now be able to redo it.[/p][/*][*][p]AI opponents should now use Ghola more intelligently.[/p][/*][*][p]The “opponent is playing a card” reminder prompt should no longer flicker when an opponent plays a Graft card.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Prepare for the Storm challenge, you should no longer be offered multiple copies of the same card in a single pick.[/p][/*][*][p]The Disposal Facilities button should no longer disappear after spending persuasion gained from Bene Gesserit Sister.[/p][/*][*][p]You should now be able to undo resolving a Research icon before actually selecting a space on the Research track.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI should now properly evaluate cards which have conditional effects that require them to have a certain amount of influence with a faction.[/p][/*][*][p]Agent box abilities should now always trigger correctly when using Usurp to play cards from the Imperium Row.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI should better evaluate when to use its Graft cards, and should no longer Graft for no benefit.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI should no longer graft Ghola to cards that trash themselves.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI should now correctly value Tleilaxu Master higher when it has at least 1 genetic marker.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Art Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]All Tech Tiles should now properly display their icons in their quick access buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]The action log entry for Tleilaxu Puppet should now show the proper thumbnail art.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Design Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Updated the challenge Ancient Duel’s flavor text to not be redundant with Resurrection.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm — a number of bugs fixed in this patch were originally reported by the community, so your dedication directly contributes to making [i]Dune: Imperium Digital [/i]the best game it can be! In that spirit, please do send your reports via the in-game feedback option or by email to [url="https://support@direwolfdigital.com"]support@direwolfdigital.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing, and happy gaming![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital 3.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][b]Today’s patch brings a fresh wave of bug fixes, visual polish, and improved AI.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Tutorial Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]The VFX highlight for the Tleilaxu track during the Immortality tutorial should now be more visible.[/p][/*][*][p]A highlight box should now correctly appear on the specimen icon during the Immortality tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]The drag-and-drop animation for Planned Coupling should now correctly appear during the Immortality tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay & Card Logic[/h3][list][*][p]Occupation should no longer grant its Combat Agent ability when revealed.[/p][/*][*][p]Drawing cards when playing to the Research Facility should now defer, allowing players to resolve other effects first.[/p][/*][*][p]Troops deployed with Counterattack should no longer count against the number of units a player can deploy from their garrison on the same turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Counterattack should no longer allow a player to deploy a dreadnought.[/p][/*][*][p]Buying Corrino Genes should grant Yuna only 3 Solari.[/p][/*][*][p]Gaining additional units after playing Occupation or High Priority Travel should reactivate the Deploy Units button and no longer show a second deploy troops button.[/p][/*][*][p]Reveal animation should now play when the Player uses Refocus during Reveal turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Using Rhombur's signet ring ability to buy Memcorders should no longer reactivate his signet ring ability.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI & Visual Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]The undo animation for cards with deferred agent abilities should now animate correctly and its icon should appear in the proper place.[/p][/*][*][p]The Control the Spice agent ability animation should now correctly display its trash and troop icons.[/p][/*][*][p]The text for Guild Impersonator’s agent ability animation should now be more legible.[/p][/*][*][p]The animation for High Priority Travel’s agent ability should now correctly show only the icon for the chosen effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Techs and Tleilaxu card acquisitions should now correctly appear in the Action Log when using the Acquisitions filter.[/p][/*][*][p]Challenge and Hagal text should now be easier to read on larger TVs (this one's for you, Xbox players!)[/p][/*][*][p]Icons on opponent facing animations should now appear at the correct size.[/p][/*][*][p]VFX should play when adding agent icons to Dispatch Envoy.[/p][/*][*][p]The Leader Select screen uses an improved layout for the playmat component buttons in the top right: view Imperium cards, view Techs, view Tleilaxu cards[/p][list][*][p]Also, gamepad users should now be able to properly access and select these buttons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]AI Behavior[/h3][list][*][p]The AI player should no longer use Finesse to lose and immediately regain influence with the same faction.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI players should make better decisions related to Reclaimed Forces.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gamepad Support[/h3][list][*][p]The gamepad selector should no longer flicker when attempting to move from an unusable ability on the Shipping Track. [/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any issues or have questions, reach out to us at [url="https://Support@DireWolfDigital.com"]Support@DireWolfDigital.com[/url] and we’ll be happy to help. And if you haven’t yet, come join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/direwolfdigital"][u]community on Discord[/u][/url] and plot your rise to power.[/p][p]
Thanks for playing Dune: Imperium![/p]

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital 3.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Our first patch following the release of [i]Immortality[/i] brings a host of fixes and stability improvements to keep the spice flowing. Thank you for the day-one feedback![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & Card Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]When using the "High Priority Travel" deferred agent ability, the stinger should now correctly show only the icon for the chosen action. [/p][/*][*][p]The text for the "Guild Impersonator" deferred agent ability stinger should now be more legible. [/p][/*][*][p]The "Occupation" card should no longer let players use a deploy ability during the Reveal turn. [/p][/*][*][p]Drawing cards when playing to the Research Facility should now be a deferred ability, allowing players to resolve other actions first. [/p][/*][*][p]Troops deployed with the "Counterattack" Intrigue card should no longer count against the number of troops a player can deploy from their garrison on the same turn. [/p][/*][*][p]The "Counterattack" Intrigue card should no longer allow a player to deploy a Dreadnought. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI & Visual Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The undo stinger for cards with deferred agent abilities should now animate correctly and have its icon in the proper place. [/p][/*][*][p]The Action Log should now include Techs and Tleilaxu card acquisitions when using the Acquisitions filter. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Error & Crash Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]In the Nuclear Mastery Challenge, Trashing Lady Jessica with the ability and using the influence to gain an alliance or the fourth influence no longer crashes the game. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, if you run into trouble or need help, drop us a line at [url="https://Support@DireWolfDigital.com"]Support@DireWolfDigital.com[/url] so we can assist. [/url]Thanks for playing [i]Dune: Imperium[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital Patch 3.0.0 – Immortality!
notes.content: [p]Today’s patch brings the [i]Immortality [/i]expansion to [i]Dune: Imperium Digital[/i], along with a number of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Expansion: Immortality[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/bb293fdc907f6e76671314db3492e78175b9ece4.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Immortality[/i] has arrived to [i]Dune: Imperium[/i]! As the Great Houses wage war, the Bene Tleilax advance their own agenda by trading in genetic innovations. Will you hire Face Dancer spies of unmatched skill? Regrow damaged tissue and organs? Or dare to employ people restored to life as gholas?[/p][p][i]Immortality [/i]expands [i]Dune: Imperium[/i] in new directions. Make shadowy deals with the Tleilaxu to harvest genetic specimens. Unlock the potential of scientific research. Graft cards together to empower your Agents.[/p][list][*][p]25 new Imperium deck cards[/p][/*][*][p]18+ Tleilaxu cards[/p][/*][*][p]10+ new Intrigue cards[/p][/*][*][p]A new starter card - Experimentation[/p][/*][*][p]Family Atomics - Gain a strategic edge by removing and replacing the Imperium row once per game[/p][/*][*][p]Go to 11 rules variant - For players who seek a slightly longer game to watch their Tleilaxu-fueled creations come to life[/p][/*][*][p]10 unique Challenges in both Normal and Heroic modes.[/p][/*][*][p]12 new achievements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]General UI & Visual Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Resource icons in control markers should now be centered correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The blue glow on opponents' reveal stingers should no longer linger when animations are set to Fast.[/p][/*][*][p]When making multiple selections that can be undone, the Undo button should now appear correctly aligned with the prompt.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual effects should no longer play on top of the expanded player HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]The highlight on the join game button should now correctly match the size of the button.[/p][/*][*][p]Private messages should now display the hamburger menu icon next to player names, similar to other messages.[/p][/*][*][p]Timestamps on private messages should now be larger and easier to read.[/p][/*][*][p]The highlight on the "Join Game" button in multiplayer lobbies should now fully cover the button.[/p][/*][*][p]The log in and cancel buttons on the account menu should now be centered correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual issues with some UI elements (like the "NEW" badge and Arrakis board space icons) at lower resolutions and High quality setting should now be resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mentat leaving animation on the board space should now be correctly sized and positioned.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mentat cleanup animation should now occur at the same time as other Agents are removed from the board, rather than after the Mentat has already disappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]Players should now be able to zoom cards in the expanded Imperium Row when a trash prompt is minimized.[/p][/*][*][p]Avatars in Game History (specifically Earl, Helena, Ilban, Ilessa, Ecaz, Tessia, Hundro) should no longer have pixels bleeding outside their avatar box.[/p][/*][*][p]The chat window should now interact more intuitively with the Tech and Imperium row modals, appearing above them when open.[/p][/*][*][p]Alliance tokens on the Player Info modal should now appear at the same time as other icons, instead of fading in after a delay.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Skip Replay" button should now have an appropriate backer, be correctly sized, and feature a non-pixelated icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Undoing the play of Intrigue and Imperium cards should now correctly animate those cards back to the player's hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Faction icons from Dispatch an Envoy should no longer cover up card text on cards like Lady Jessica or Bene Gesserit Initiate.[/p][/*][*][p]News panels in Direbytes on Steam Deck should now appear at consistent heights.[/p][/*][*][p]Black pillar boxes should no longer appear on wide-screen displays.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & Card Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Players should now receive a Masterstroke warning prompt when trashing Treachery to add troops, if this action would trigger Masterstroke, regardless of the order of operations.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI Player in Rise of Ix should now correctly choose to recall at level 1 on the Shipping Track (if it has Swordmaster) when gaining spice would allow it to acquire a valuable Tech tile.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Gamepad Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The gamepad cursor should no longer become excessively large when hovering over Agent icons.[/p][/*][*][p]The gamepad selector VFX on the Deck button of the Other Memory prompt should now be synchronized and displayed correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabling controller support in settings should now correctly prevent all gamepad button inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]The card acquisition animation on gamepad when acquiring cards that trigger a second prompt (like Lady Jessica or via Recruitment Mission) should now be consistently sized and positioned.[/p][/*][*][p]The Animation Speed slider in settings should no longer have a non-functional "ghost" selection target for gamepads.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Tutorial Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The "Persuasion Cost" label should no longer overlap the Persuasion cost of Sardaukar Legion during the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Several card icons should no longer flash briefly when hovering over Reconnaissance during a specific point in Tutorial 1.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Machinations" tutorial should now be clearly identified as the Rise of Ix tutorial on the tutorial page.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Rise of Ix Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Cancel button in some Rise of Ix prompts should now appear correctly positioned within the prompt.[/p][/*][*][p]Alliance icons should no longer be covered up by the tech negotiators icon in Rise of Ix.[/p][/*][*][p]Tech tiles in Rise of Ix modals should no longer bounce up and down constantly when mousing between tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Tessia's Careful Observation Bonus 1 ability button in Rise of Ix, when triggered by winning combat without cards in hand to discard, should now auto-resolve.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Localization Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The poison snooper prompt in Italian should no longer display overlapped text in the header, and the card image should not overlap prompt text.[/p][/*][*][p]The prompt appearing when Play History fails to load should now be properly localized.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Immortality[/p][list][*][p]Players on older 2.2 game clients who resume a game on the new 3.0 server the "May Undo" cursor may be incorrect for two cards: Test of Humanity and Reverend Mother Mohiam.This will correct itself when players update their app to version 3.0.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Steam store v. In-game store[/p][list][*][p]The Steam store listing can take approximately half an hour to appear in all locales, even though it shows in the in-game shop.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]As always, if you run into trouble or need help, drop us a line at [url="https://Support@DireWolfDigital.com"]Support@DireWolfDigital.com[/url] so we can help. And if you haven’t, be sure to join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/direwolfdigital"][u]player community on Discord![/u][/url][/p][p]Thanks for playing [i]Dune: Imperium[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Immortality is Coming Soon to Dune: Imperium Digital
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/4c409bafcacf8143da7ab4499d2b3a4111971f38.jpg[/img]

As the Great Houses wage war, the Bene Tleilax advance their own agenda by trading in genetic innovations. Make shadowy deals with the Tleilaxu to harvest genetic specimens, unlock the potential of scientific research, and graft cards together to empower your Agents in [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595530/Dune_Imperium__Immortality/]Immortality,[/url][/b][/i] coming soon to Dune: Imperium Digital!

[h2]What Immortality Brings to Dune: Imperium Digital[/h2]
[i]The Bene Tleilax, or Tleilaxu, are a powerful fringe society in the Imperium, specializing in genetic engineering. House leaders must carefully consider the costs of dealing with them, both financial and ethical. Tleilaxu replacement organs are widely used throughout the Imperium, but their genetic grafting programs and hybrid creations are looked upon with suspicion.[/i]

[h2]The Bene Tleilax Board[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/2ee7a7210604e5f918125f038053bb20780ba7de.jpg[/img]

The [b]Bene Tleilax board[/b] tracks each player’s relationship with the shadowy Tleilaxu in two ways: the research track and the [b]Tleilaxu track.[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]The Research Track:[/b] The research track represents each House’s scientific gains from their involvement with the Tleilaxu. By engaging with the [b]Research [/b]icon, you can move forward on this track. With a litany of branching paths to choose from, you get to choose which rewards you reap from the Bene Tleilax’s machinations.
[*] [b]The Tleilaxu Track: [/b]This track represents your favor with the Tleilaxu, which you can advance by activating the beetle-shaped [b]Tleilaxu [/b]icon. Similar to other factions, you can gain Victory Points by moving up on this track, but there’s no Alliance to be formed here — the Bene Tleilax are shrewd in their dealings, and their services are offered to all Houses willing to embrace their twisted ambitions.
[/list]
[h2]Tleilaxu Cards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/359e994239976c234a5bb294f472e72e6d4152cc.png[/img]
The unique creations of the Bene Tleilax are represented on [b]Tleilaxu cards. [/b]These cards are functionally similar to Imperium cards, but with a key difference: instead of acquiring them with Persuasion, Tleilaxu cards sit on their own row and can only be acquired with [b]specimens. [/b]

You can collect specimens (represented by cubes from your supply) by activating [b]specimen icons[/b] on various cards and board spaces. Once you have enough, you can spend them during the Reveal phase to acquire powerful Tleilaxu cards. Will you hire Face Dancer spies of unmatched skill? Regrow damaged tissue and organs? Or dare to employ people restored to life as gholas? Many surprises will await your foes as you bring these new tools to the conflict on Arrakis.

[h2]Card Grafting: Unlock Powerful New Deck-Building Potential[/h2]
[i]Immortality[/i] brings [b]48 new cards[/b] to [i]Dune: Imperium Digital,[/i] comprising 18 Tleilaxu cards and [b]30 new Imperium cards.[/b] Many of these cards include the [b]Graft[/b] effect, allowing you to [b]play two cards together[/b] in an Agent turn!

Graft cards can’t be played alone; they [i]must[/i] be combined with another card. But once grafted together, both cards act as one, granting you access to both of their Agent icons and card effects for the turn. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/1f7053162efab215d887e46ebafced79eaa21dd4.jpg[/img]

This unlocks powerful new combinations. What new opportunities await you when you can use your [b]Signet Ring[/b] on faction spaces? How will your opponents react when you bring your [b]Sardaukar Legion[/b] straight into a battle space? Grafting brings a whole new world of possibilities to your games of [i]Dune: Imperium Digital.[/i]

But it’s not just the cards you’re familiar with that will benefit from Grafting; certain new cards in [i]Immortality[/i] have unique effects that trigger only when Grafted. With familiar cards gaining new utility and new cards introducing comboing potential, deck-building is taken to an entirely new level in [i]Immortality![/i]

[h2]Family Atomics[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/d99a0aa36dbee8c0c228c236579f7f1fe8b2df9c.jpg[/img]

Feeling nonplussed about your options in the Imperium row? Want to deny your opponent a card that you know you can’t let them have? [i]Immortality[/i] gives each player a [b]Family Atomics[/b] token, which can be used once per game to completely replace the card row.

[h2]New Challenges[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/ec3ae0106b8496895c58735b105cbb1ce1e6a875.jpg[/img]

[b]Ten new Challenges[/b] come to [i]Dune: Imperium Digital[/i] in this expansion, allowing you to run wild with the new mechanics from [i]Immortality.[/i] As with the base game and [i]Rise of Ix,[/i] each of these Challenges will include a Heroic variant with even more difficult AI and win conditions. 

[h2]Compatibility with Rise of Ix[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/024bfc9606364341b7fb027a519529420d014a10.jpg[/img]

[i]Immortality[/i] is compatible with the base game as a standalone expansion, and it can also be combined with [i]Rise of Ix![/i] When creating a game, you can choose which expansion[s] to include. [i]Rise of Ix’s[/i] Epic Mode is compatible with [i]Immortality,[/i] and [i]Immortality[/i] has a variant of its own, [b]Go to 11,[/b] which allows you to play to 11 points, and is compatible with both [i]Ix[/i] and the base game.

[h2]Expand the Imperium[/h2]
With the Tleilaxu setting their sights on the desert planet, the conflict on Arrakis will never be the same. We’ll have more to say about [i]Immortality[/i] in the coming weeks, including a release date and additional previews. With new cards, mechanics, and unprecedented new deck-building potential, [i]Immortality[/i] is set to transform your games of [i]Dune: Imperium[/i] when it arrives. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595530/Dune_Imperium__Immortality/]Wishlist it today![/url]

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital Patch 2.2.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/f7a36a7aa2347b0e560b9e59b437f35ed29cbf0a.png[/img]

This release fixes a few rules bugs and corrects some iOS display issues on the skirmish results screen.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where reserve cards could not be purchased if one was trashed from discard the same turn.
[*] Fixed a bug where Shai-Hulud would incorrectly give an extra strength in combination with Artillery or Imperial Bashar.
[*] Fixed a few iOS display issues on the skirmish results screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where canceling Imperial Bashar's trash ability could freeze the application.
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The cursor on 4K displays is too small.
[*] Tech tile activations can appear in the previous player’s action log
[*] Missing warning for gaining Tech Negotiators when at troop supply limit.
[*] Troops gained from purchasing Invasion Ships take too long to go into garrison due to individual VFX.
[*] When using the Unexpected Terrain rules mod, the number of remaining Conflict I cards is not communicated.
[*] In a Vs AI game, when a player ends their turn saves, and then resumes, they resume before their end of turn.
[/list]

As always, if you run into trouble or need help, drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com so we can help. And if you haven’t, be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]join our player community on Discord![/url]

Thanks for playing [i]Dune: Imperium[/i]!

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital 2.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/86ee184dc139eabffdb37c8d9c865c4f089b5703.png[/img]
[h2]A Note About Ranked Rollover[/h2]
Today’s patch release unintentionally caused the current Ranked season to end, and a new one to begin. (We’re apparently in one of the timelines we weren’t able to foresee.) We’ve been investigating the issue and, while we’ve identified the cause, it’s not something that we’d be able to undo without additional complications.  Because of this, we’ve decided to allow the premature rollover to stand, and the new Ranked season to play out as normal, starting today and ending on April 1st. Apologies to those affected!
[h2]New Features![/h2]
[h3]Player Stats[/h3]
By popular demand, game stats are coming to [i]Dune: Imperium[/i]! Going forward, you can track your win rate with each leader, your favorite alliance, average conflicts won, and much more! [i](Adding historical play data is a work in progress.)[/i]
[h3]Game History[/h3]
Ever wanted to keep better track of your past matches? You can now view your last 20 games, including details like your placement, VP, rounds, spice, and chosen leader. 
[h3]Additional Animation Speed Settings[/h3]
Expanded to include five speed options, ranging from a new slower-than-default setting up to 4x speed.
[h3]Ranked Play Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Your current stars are now displayed on your ranked badge on the ranked play landing page.
[*] Star gain and loss prompts now include details about the referenced game, such as start time and opponent names.
[/list][h3]Rise of Ix Tech Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Added spice and Tech Negotiator counts to the tech offer tooltip.
[*] You can now tooltip an enemy’s tech count to see which tech they own.
[*] Each tech stack in the offer now indicates how many tech are available.
[*] Various polish improvements to tech highlights and mouse-over states.[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list][*] Undoing an action that topdecks a card now returns the card to its previous spot.
[*] Refocus can be played either before or after each deferred card draw.
[*] A Disposal Facility button ability appears on the Reveal prompt.[/list]
[h3]AI[/h3]
[list][*] Improved AI's discard behavior to ensure it more consistently discards lower value cards.
[*] Improved timing logic for AI using Glimpse the Path.[/list]
[h3]Ranked[/h3]
[list][*] Ranking up or down at season turnover now plays SFX.
[*] Added some missing localized strings related to Ranked play.[/list]
[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list][*] Undoing an action no longer undoes an earned Achievement.
[*] Muad'Dib and Kwisatz Haderach now properly unlock when their criteria are met.
[*] Android achievements now yield XP.[/list]
[h3]Action Log[/h3]
[list][*] Tech Negotiation's action log entries now have an appropriate icon.
[*] Action log entries for Invasion Ship discards now fit within their text box.
[*] Restricted Ordnance shows bonus strength in the Action Log only when a player has a High Council Seat.[/list]
[h3]Visual[/h3]
[list][*] The Take a Seat rules mod now shows a Restricted Ordnance icon.
[*] Epic Mode games in the lobby directory now display an identifying icon.
[*] Card art properly displays in the animation for cards that trash themselves.
[*] The animations for Double Cross now play in the order indicated by the card's text.
[*] Recalling a Freighter now plays its own animation.
[*] Fixed a case where playing one's last Tech Tile and then undoing that play didn't restore the VFX to indicate they have 1 or more Techs in hand.
[*] Recalling a freighter from the 2nd or 3rd place now plays a single opponent leader stinger, not two.
[*] Sonic Snoopers now has a top-level ability button over the player's local HUD.
[*] Improved button layout and sizing on the Reveal prompt.
[*] The tab order for a player's expanded HUD and the tab order for an opponent's expanded HUD now use the same order
[*] When acquiring cards during the Reveal phase, the acquire area is moved to a more accessible position on the right.
[*] Fixed pagination arrows in the player info modal that were obstructing some content in Tessia's expanded HUD.
[*] Fixed a case where adding 2+ cards to the top of one's deck with Spaceport produced blank thumbnails in the Imperium Row preview sidebar.
[*] In the Waste Not skirmish modifier, Fremen Cards in the sidebar Imperium Preview Row show a trash acquire effect icon.
[*] Control marker tooltips now include information for Dreadnoughts and their owners.
[*] Dragging a card to the Imperium Row acquire area now uses an undo cursor.
[*] Conflict Results for the heroic challenge Neutral Shipping Conglomerate no longer display VP earned when a player fails to have a dreadnought in combat.
[*] Imperium Row will show only different-cost cards during setup when the Diversity Initiative rules mod is active.
[*] Rapid Mobilization hints only when a player has troops, not just dreadnoughts, in their garrison.[/list]
[h3]Mobile[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an assortment of visual issues on mobile layouts, particularly for tablet and widescreen phones.
[*] Tablet users will now see the Skip Replay button
[*] iOS years should get push notifications, so long as they're not disabled in the OS[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list][*] The password box on the Create Game screen completely fills its frame.
[*] Adding friends from the playmat now shows a properly sized confirmation prompt.
[*] Players can now chat on the Create Game screen.
[*] Usernames and timestamps no longer overlap on the in-game chat preview.
[*] Entering the online play menu no longer flashes Ranked information
[*] Entering a lobby game password after the game creator has left the game no longer freezes the client.[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed some buttons in the tutorial to attach properly to Rabban's prompts.
[*] Fixed some Rise of Ix tutorial pointers intruding on the buttons to which they pointed.
[*] Fixed an assortment of localization errors.
[*] Improved kudos messaging for users earning a skirmish badge at end of season.
[*] On Steam Deck, Ilesa's One Step Ahead hanger is now fully on-screen.
[*] Fixed positioning and highlights for some gamepad buttons.[/list]
[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] After this update, there are potentially issues involving saved games disappearing; updating your client should fix this, but if it doesn’t please contact us at Support@DireWolfDigital.com with your device info and client version to help us investigate.
[*] Ranked Season was rolled several days ahead of time, resulting in users getting reset sooner than expected.
[*] Clicking on/Selecting your discard pile, erroneously opens a view of your deck.
[*] When you recall your freighter and gain troops and are at or near the supply limit, you do not see a warning that it will not grant you the expected number of troops
[*] The Tech Negotiation Persuasion tooltip in Reveal Action Log entry provides no meaningful information
[*] Player does not get a Masterstroke warning when Treachery troops are added after deploy
[*] AI will not choose to recall at level 1 on Shipping Track when gaining spice could get them a strong Tech tile
[*] Stinger does not display for discarded card in Skirmish with Desperate Measures rules modifier
[*] Action log does not correctly reflect number of Tech Negotiators gained when troop supply is empty
[*] Players are not warned when attempting to gain Tech Negotiators if they do not have enough troops in the supply
[*] Troops gained from purchasing Invasion Ships take too long to go into garrison due to individual VFX
[*] Unexpected Terrain does not list the number of remaining Conflict I cards
[*] Other players appear offline when 2+ players resume an async game at the exact same time
[*] When Tessia's Careful Observation Bonus 1 is triggered via winning combat, ability button appears that can be selected to no effect
[*] Saving after player ends their turn in vs. AI resumes the player before they ended their turn
[*] Tech Swords for Restricted Ordinance are displaying incorrectly in action log[/list]

As always, if you run into trouble or need help, drop us a line at Support@DireWolfDigital.com so can see what’s up. And if you haven’t, be sure to join our player community on Discord!

Thanks for playing [i]Dune: Imperium[/i]!

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital 2.1.7 Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/a7e2de766506b4ec67ce249265c9f2b706d3ae23.jpg[/img]

We’re kicking off the New Year with a ton of improvements, including a new [b]Skip Repla[/b]y feature and Animation Speed Controls. Go get that Spice.

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital Ranked Play
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/342419f72858e7e580c4c4896cdcef6bab646249.jpg[/img]

Today’s patch releases [b][i]Rise of Ix[/i][/b] cross-platform on phones, tablets & XBOX, and introduces our first test of Ranked Play for [i]Dune: Imperium Digital[/i]!

Ranked Play for 4-player board games has some special considerations relative to more traditional 2-player games. We’re excited about this initial approach, and looking forward to player feedback to help guide iteration and ongoing development – so let us know what you think!

Here’s everything you need to know about how it currently works, to prepare for your conquest of the known universe and/or Leaderboards:

[h2][i]Rise of Ix[/i] Ranked Play[/h2]
Looking to scratch that competitive itch? Ranked Play matches begin every hour, on the hour in a special queue in the Online Play menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/432408ed42c90bc2d1535b4841add30b9bdaf546.jpg[/img]

Ranked Games require Rise of Ix to play, and match players against other players of similar levels of skill and experience, creating tables of four whenever possible.

[h2]Ranking Up[/h2]
In Ranked Play, you’ll earn Stars – two for finishing First, one for finishing Second – that will help you rank up through five tiers from Bronze to Master. At ranks Gold and above, finishing last or disconnecting from a game will cause you to lose a Star, so it’s important to fight to the finish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/03709301aeacf1e93ba574804f2867cd1f8cc56b.jpg[/img]

You’ll need progressively more Stars to rank up…but don’t worry: Losing Stars won’t cause you to lose a rank.

[h2]Seasonal Leaderboards[/h2]
A new season kicks off every 30 days, with a fresh chance to make your mark as one of the Top 100 players on the Master Leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/8ed11927a3a3ede30ee3c612a04440f036e1f45b.jpg[/img]

With each new season, the Leaderboard resets and all players lose two Ranks (dropping from Master to Gold, or Gold to Bronze, for example), with a new chance to fight your way to the top!



Ranked Play raises the stakes for Dune: Imperium Digital with a new way to test your mettle against your fellow players.  May thy knife chip and shatter!

notes.title: The Golden Path – Dune: Imperium Digital Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/37801789814820daacdf6a68ae23248e18291198.jpg[/img]

With tomorrow’s release of [i]Dune: Imperium Digital[/i], we’re looking ahead towards visions of the future. Here’s some of what we’re working on in the coming months:


[h1]Rise of Ix[/h1]
In 2022, Rise of Ix, the fist expansion for Dune: Imperium, won both the Golden Geek Award and Dice Tower Award for Best Board Game Expansion. With new leaders, new cards, fearsome dreadnoughts in the skies above and the technological innovations of the planet Ix reshaping the conflict on Arrakis below, Rise of Ix tests your strategic abilities like never before.

Development on Rise of Ix is already well underway, and we’re anticipating its arrival this summer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/acc930a51a73cbcb9b046aea09fe21d64976ebef.png[/img]
[i]Preview image; gameplay not final. (This is but a vision of one of many possible futures.)
[/i]

[h1]Player Profiles & Ranked Play[/h1]
We’ve heard from players with a mentat-like capacity for tracking and analyzing their games. So we’re developing player Profiles to help show how you stack up against the competition, and better track your progress as a whole.

We’re also working towards implementing Ranked play options, as well as a karma system to improve match quality for casual games by prioritizing pairing players who finish games rather than quitting.

Together, these systems will give you more control over how you play Dune: Imperium Digital, and more ways to see your growth as a player.


[h1]Events & Organized Play[/h1]
After two successful test events during Early Access, the core structure of the in-game events system is in a pretty good place, but there’s a lot more in store. We’re working towards expanded offerings that include new event structures and logic, qualifier & invitational events, prizes, and a broader structure of organized, competitive play.

There are a lot of moving pieces to putting together a satisfying, competitive experience, and we’re listening to players and learning from both on- and off-line events from around the world to help figure out what the road ahead here will look like.

We’ll continue to offer one-off events as the systems take shape, and will have more announcements about the future of competitive play in the coming months.

So there’s lots more in the works for[i] Dune: Imperium Digital[/i]! For now, though, we’re looking forward to tomorrow’s release and welcoming new players into our growing community.

Thank you so much to those of you who have been with us from the beginning – you help us keep the spice flowing.

[i]– The Dire Wolf Team[/i]

notes.title: Dune: Imperium Digital Skirmish Mode
notes.content:
With Dune: Imperium Digital now in Early Access on Steam, we are excited to introduce the community to Skirmish, a brand new game mode with ever changing rules and scoring modifiers!

In Skirmish, you explore fast paced PVE games against AI opponents where your scores determine your placement on the global leaderboard as you vie for coveted seasonal badges.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/4fb82979f88d3cb109efa24d6a0db179ad4c058d.jpg[/img]


[h1]Twists and Turns[/h1]
Every three days a new Skirmish begins with all players competing under the same set of unique rules and scoring modifiers.

In the example above, the rules modifier “Dynasty” gives each player an extra Signet Ring in place of one of their Dune, the Desert Planet cards. And that’s just the tip of the sandworm – more than 35 other rules modifiers await you in future skirmishes!

[h1]Leaderboard Scoring[/h1]
At the end of each of your first three games in a Skirmish, your leaderboard score is determined by your finish using traditional game rules:

[list]
[*] 1st place: 20 points
[*] 2nd place: 10 points
[*] 3rd place: 5 points
[*] 4th place: 0 points
[/list]

In addition, each Skirmish comes with a set of special objectives which increase your leaderboard rank. In the example above, there is a bonus for each time you shuffle your deck and a bonus for using the Mentat.

So if you finished 2nd, shuffled your deck seven times and dispatched your trusty Mentat twice, your score for the Skirmish would be 10 + 7 + 2 = 19 points.

Each creates new incentives and strategies. For example, trashing and drawing cards can help you maximize the shuffle bonus, while the Mentat bonus can be maximized by using leaders that reward playing to green spaces like Duke Leto and Count Ilban.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/9de0ad618ad545b0c06337e28acc4dd02b2a3f24.jpg[/img]

You can choose any leader for the Skirmish, so we suggest experimenting to see which is the right fit for maximizing the rules mods and scoring bonuses.

[h1]Leaderboard Placement[/h1]

Each Season lasts for around 30 days, and consists of ten Skirmishes, and each Skirmish is available for three days. Your leaderboard placement for each Skirmish game is determined by the highest score achieved among your first three attempts.

At the conclusion of the season, your performance across the 10 Skirmishes is totaled to create your season score. To showcase your progress, badges are awarded based on your rank:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44486952/40cc4538223be16169663c55ddf72857aa77c4a4.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Ranks 1-100: Gold Badge
[*] Ranks 101-500: Silver Badge
[*] Ranks 501-1000: Bronze Badge
[/list]

These badges serve as a testament to your achievements and will prominently feature next to your name on the leaderboard throughout subsequent seasons, allowing you to proudly display your past success!

The Skirmish is already underway! As Gurney teaches us, “You fight when the necessity arises,” so go out there and show your mettle!
